scope: Isolated textqa release WebView2 with synthetic A/B/C notes and authorized synthetic outside/non-Markdown files. Normal Open uses the double-gated fixture queue; links use real preview and editor mouse gestures. No production source changes, user notes, clipboard or Run-key modifications.

checks.name: Real Tauri text_read accepts optional knownVersion, omits an unchanged original body, and preserves the legacy full TextFile wire shape
A real preview-link click activates the existing dirty C text owner, preserves all text IDs and original bytes, and returns to the unchanged A | B notes layout
An ordinary editor-link click only positions the cursor and leaves the A | B notes module active
A real Ctrl+click activates the same dirty C text owner and returning preserves the source B editor mode and A | B layout
